summaryZh: Hunter 实验室研究蛋白质化学修饰如何控制细胞周期与生长，以及癌症如何破坏这些调节程序。团队使用分子、遗传和细胞生物学技术，研究包括酪氨酸磷酸化在内的调控机制并寻找癌症治疗靶点。
researchQuestions: 蛋白质的化学修饰如何控制细胞周期和细胞生长？

evidence.quote: his lab has led the field in understanding how chemical additions to proteins control the cell cycle and growth. Hunter uses cutting-edge molecular, genetic, and cell biology techniques to probe how these programs interact with each other, what effect they have on cells, and how cancers disrupt them to encourage uninhibited growth.
